mainText: Earthquakes in Venezuela resulted in 920 deaths.
President Trump threatened a 100% tariff on European imports if countries impose a tax on digital services.
A death toll climbs following an earthquake in Venezuela, and search operations for missing persons are underway.
Israel and Lebanon signed a framework agreement, according to Secretary of State Marco Rubio.
An Ebola outbreak is occurring in the Democratic Republic of Congo more than one month after its start, and doctors state the epidemic will continue.
